name: libvirt (outside of Docker)
description: Installs the libvirt client tools (virsh, virt-install) and prepares the dev container to manage the virtual machines of the host's libvirt daemon through a mount of the host's /run/libvirt that you add: qemu:///system is the default connection, and at every start the remote user is given access to the mounted socket.

virtInstall.description: Install virt-install, which also provides virt-clone and virt-xml.

qemuImg.description: Install qemu-img. An image it creates is useful to the host's daemon only at a path the host sees too.
